items.notes: In Figma the Accordion shows every item open while their chevrons point down. In code only the first item is open with its chevron up. The Figma variants should look like the code.

results.title: Draw items closed except the first, chevrons matching
results.summary: In Figma every Accordion item is drawn open while its chevron points down. In code only the first item is open, with its chevron up, and the others are closed. Drawing the variants like the code keeps designs and the product in step.
